                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",

                  "blurred movement",
                  "dodge icons",

                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_PIT_4C71AC",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",

                "scene_id": 5,
                "summary": "Neither can land a hit for ten minutes. The crowd starts booing. Fizz suggests using an unconventional item to break the stalemate.",

                  "booing crowd",
                  "flying tomatoes",
                  "sweat beads",
                  "ticking clock"

                  "glowing trophy",
                  "swarm of flies",
                  "rogue's distraction",
                  "final crit spark"

                "transition_out_text": "Artie pulls the Participation Trophy from his inventory.",

                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"

                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "5:5",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",

                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_PIT_4C71AC",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "outcome": "Artie wins, but the 'Trophy' is now glowing with dark energy.",

                  "rogue's distraction",
                  "final crit spark"

                  "stone bench"

                  "CHAR_FIZZ"

                "constraint_state": "restricted",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "5:6",

                  "dark energy pulses",
                  "random debuff icon",
                  "stone bench"
                ],

                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "inverted control icon",
                  "dizzy stars",
                  "confused crowd",
                  "stumbling animation"
                ],

              }

                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",

                  "dizzy stars",
                  "confused crowd",
                  "stumbling animation"

                  "moonwalk dodge",
                  "fire pits",
                  "mage's panic"

                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_PIT_4C71AC",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "outcome": "Artie manages to reach the Mage and lands a crit that turns the Mage's staff into a rubber chicken.",
                "scene_id": 9,
                "summary": "Artie's opponent is a Mage who uses AOE spells. Artie has to 'moonwalk' through the fireballs.",
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "rubber chicken staff",
                  "moonwalk dodge",
                  "fire pits",
                  "mage's panic"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Artie dodges a blast of flame with an accidental slide.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "white surrender flag",
                  "squeaking rubber",
                  "laughing crowd",
                  "victory fanfare"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The Mage looks at the squeaking chicken in his hand and sighs.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_ARTIE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "5:9",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "5:11",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_PIT_4C71AC",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_THE_PIT_4C71AC",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - The Pit",
                "outcome": "Artie reaches the finals.",
                "scene_id": 10,
                "summary": "The Mage surrenders out of pure embarrassment.",
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "white surrender flag",
                  "squeaking rubber",
                  "laughing crowd",
                  "victory fanfare"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The victory fanfare plays as the Mage walks out of the ring.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "system override scroll",
                  "black market seal",
                  "cruel laughter",
                  "arena torchlight"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Vane stands in the darkness of the player tunnel, watching.",
                "type": "aftermath"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "CHAR_VANE"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "5:10",
                "end_condition_echo": "Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "location_end": "Grand Arena - Shadowed Tunnel",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_SHADOWED_TUNNEL_FB667C",
                "location_end_label": "Grand Arena - Shadowed Tunnel",
                "location_start": "Grand Arena - Shadowed Tunnel",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_GRAND_ARENA_SHADOWED_TUNNEL_FB667C",
                "location_start_label": "Grand Arena - Shadowed Tunnel",
                "outcome": "The final fight will be rigged.",
                "scene_id": 11,
                "summary": "Vane watches from the wings, holding a 'System Override' scroll he bought from the black market, preparing to sabotage Artie's final match.",
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "system override scroll",
                  "black market seal",
                  "cruel laughter",
                  "arena torchlight"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Vane's cruel laughter echoes in the stone tunnel.",
                "type": "reveal"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "The Semi-Finals: The Debuff"
          }
        ],
        "stakes_shift": "Artie becomes a crowd favorite, which makes the System even more eager to 'balance' him.",
        "title": "The Tournament of Tiers"
      }
    ]
  },
  "cast_report": {
    "core_character_ids": [
      "CHAR_ARTIE"
    ],
    "supporting_character_ids": [
      "CHAR_FIZZ",
      "CHAR_VANE"
    ],
    "episodic_character_ids": [],
    "recurring_without_job_count": 0,
    "edits_applied": [
      "Verified Fizz's role as tactical advisor and System-mechanic commentator in Scenes 2, 5, and 7.",
      "Verified Vane's role as antagonist setup and primary source of upcoming conflict in Scene 11.",
      "Confirmed episodic opponents (Tank, Rogue, Mage) remain nameless to focus on Artie's mechanical progression and avoid cast bloat."
    ]
  }
}
